description: This file contains function declarations, macros, and inline functions for managing mustach string buffers, memory files, file reading, escaping, and memory streams in the mustach templating library.

methods.name: mustach_sbuf_reset
methods.description: Resets a mustach_sbuf_t buffer to its initial state.

methods.name: mustach_sbuf_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a mustach_sbuf_t buffer.

methods.name: mustach_sbuf_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the mustach_sbuf_t buffer.

methods.name: mustach_stream_end
methods.description: Finalizes a mustach_stream_t and retrieves buffer and size.

methods.name: mustach_stream_write_cb
methods.description: Writes data to a mustach_stream_t using a callback.
